name: Telegram Trigger
category_description: Trigger node - starts a workflow when an event happens
description: Telegram is a cloud-based instant messaging and voice over IP service. Users can send messages and exchange photos, videos, stickers, audio, and files of any type. On this page, you'll find a list of events the Telegram Trigger node can respond to and links to more resources

parameters.name: Download Images/Files
parameters.description: Whether to download attached images or files to include in the output data

parameters.name: Restrict to Chat IDs
parameters.description: Only trigger for events with the listed chat IDs. You can include multiple chat IDs separated by commas

parameters.name: Restrict to User IDs
parameters.description: Only trigger for events with the listed user IDs. You can include multiple user IDs separated by commas

events.name: Business Connection
events.description: Trigger when the bot is connected to or disconnected from a business account, or a user edited an existing connection with the bot

events.name: Business Message
events.description: Trigger on a new message from a connected business account

events.name: Callback Query
events.description: Trigger on new incoming callback query

events.name: Channel Post
events.description: Trigger on new incoming channel post of any kind — including text, photo, sticker, and so on

events.name: Chat Boost
events.description: Trigger when a chat boost is added or changed. The bot must be an administrator in the chat to receive these updates

events.name: Chat Join Request
events.description: Trigger when a request to join the chat is sent. The bot must have the can_invite_users administrator right in the chat to receive these updates

events.name: Chat Member
events.description: Trigger when a chat member's status is updated. The bot must be an administrator in the chat

events.name: Chosen Inline Result
events.description: Trigger when the result of an inline query chosen by a user is sent. Please see Telegram's API documentation on feedback collection for details on how to enable these updates for your bot

events.name: Deleted Business Messages
events.description: Trigger when messages are deleted from a connected business account

events.name: Edited Business Message
events.description: Trigger on new version of a message from a connected business account

events.name: Edited Channel Post
events.description: Trigger on new version of a channel post that is known to the bot is edited

events.name: Edited Message
events.description: Trigger on new version of a message that is known to the bot and was edited

events.name: Inline Query
events.description: Trigger on new incoming inline query

events.name: Message
events.description: Trigger on new incoming message of any kind — text, photo, sticker, and so on

events.name: Message Reaction
events.description: Trigger when a reaction to a message is changed by a user. The bot must be an administrator in the chat. The update isn't received for reactions set by bots

events.name: Message Reaction Count
events.description: Trigger when reactions to a message with anonymous reactions are changed. The bot must be an administrator in the chat. The updates are grouped and can be sent with delay up to a few minutes

events.name: My Chat Member
events.description: Trigger when the bot's chat member status is updated in a chat. For private chats, this update is received only when the bot is blocked or unblocked by the user

events.name: Poll
events.description: Trigger on new poll state. Bots only receive updates about stopped polls and polls which are sent by the bot

events.name: Poll Answer
events.description: Trigger when user changes their answer in a non-anonymous poll. Bots only receive new votes in polls that were sent by the bot itself

events.name: Pre-Checkout Query
events.description: Trigger on new incoming pre-checkout query. Contains full information about checkout

events.name: Purchased Paid Media
events.description: Trigger when a user purchases paid media with a non-empty payload sent by the bot in a non-channel chat

events.name: Removed Chat Boost
events.description: Trigger when a boost is removed from a chat. The bot must be an administrator in the chat to receive these updates

events.name: Shipping Query
events.description: Trigger on new incoming shipping query. Only for invoices with flexible price

common_issues.title: Stuck waiting for trigger event
common_issues.summary: When testing the Telegram Trigger node with the Execute step or Execute workflow buttons, the execution may appear stuck and unable to stop listening for events. If this occurs, you may need to exit the workflow and open it again to reset the canvas

common_issues.title: Bad request: bad webhook: An HTTPS URL must be provided for webhook
common_issues.summary: This error occurs when you run n8n behind a reverse proxy and there is a problem with your instance's webhook URL

common_issues.title: Workflow only works in testing or production
common_issues.summary: Telegram only allows you to register a single webhook per app. This means that every time you switch from using the testing URL to the production URL (and vice versa), Telegram overwrites the registered webhook URL

parameters.name: attachmentNotice
parameters.displayName: Every uploaded attachment, even if sent in a group, will trigger a separate event. You can identify that an attachment belongs to a certain group by media_group_id .

options.name: download
options.description: Telegram delivers the image in multiple sizes. By default, just the large image would be downloaded. If you want to change the size, set the field 'Image Size'.

options.name: imageSize
options.description: The size of the image to be downloaded

options.name: chatIds
